answer: Sybil resistance arises because every identity must post bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers a quadratic O(k^2) penalty charged against their escrows. Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to the controller’s loss, making a large swarm economically fatal rather than merely costly. Thus violet, timber, and pearl identities cannot diversify one attacker’s risk.
